description: New General ACCDB. T(ID Long primary key, K TEXT(40)) with the first 24 pair-corpus values in ID order; then the indexes IX1 (K), IX2 (K DESC), IX3 (K, ID) are built one after another with a whole-file image kept after each. Reads the IX1, IX2 and IX3 walks and every index's metadata. Asks what each index build changes in the file and whether the order of builds changes the final image, the walks or the reported index order (the same probe with the build order reversed is image-build-order-b).
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
